text: Campfire is an essential part of camping. It provides warmth, light, and a sense of community. With a campfire, you can create a cozy atmosphere and share stories with fellow campers. As the night winds down, you can roast marshmallows, boil water, and enjoy delicious food. A tent is also important for camping, as it provides shelter from the elements and keeps you safe and dry. In addition to these two essential elements, other things you should bring include a fire starter, a flashlight, a first aid kit, and a map.
